note: Per-image cost figures are estimates scaled from published per-query measurements: energy from Luccioni, Jernite & Strubell, "Power Hungry Processing" (2023, ~2.9 Wh mean per generated image); water from Li, Yang, Islam & Ren, "Making AI Less Thirsty" (2023, 1.8-12 L/kWh by site). Coordinates are published hyperscale data-center locations. Providers do not disclose per-query figures; estimation is the point.
